subject: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway Comprehensive Permit
overview: The board reviewed and approved a draft decision for a 350-unit residential development under MGL Chapter 40B, following deliberations on infrastructure waivers and public art conditions.

items.title: Case 40B-2022-01: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway
items.summary: The board conducted a section-by-section review of a 32-page draft decision for an eight-story, 350-unit apartment complex with 25% affordable units.

items.title: Factual Findings and Fire Safety Conditions
items.summary: The board modified factual findings to detail fire safety concerns regarding wood-frame construction and the requirement for a phased occupancy plan approved by the Fire Chief.

items.title: Environmental and Utility Conditions
items.summary: The board added language encouraging the applicant to utilize electric utilities and meet specialized stretch code requirements should the city adopt them.

items.title: Public Art and Indigenous History Consultation
items.summary: Approved a condition requiring a formal call for artists with equity-led selection criteria for the project's mural, to be developed in consultation with the Medford Arts Council and Historical Society.

items.title: Linkage Fee Waiver
items.summary: Approved a partial linkage fee waiver of $758,000 for the market-rate units in recognition of off-site intersection improvements, sewer mitigation, and other public benefits.

items.title: Zoning Ordinance Waivers
items.summary: The board reviewed and approved technical waivers from various sections of the zoning ordinance, including dimensional requirements, parking standards, and signage.

items.title: Final Decision and Permit Approval
items.summary: Approved the comprehensive permit and authorized the chair to sign the final decision after technical corrections are made by staff.
